quality.schedHelp: Runs the whole check by itself every day, so a drop in quality (a case that used to pass and now fails) is noticed without anyone looking. It uses the CRM rights of the administrator who saves the schedule, and writes a warning to the Logs page when something fails.
quality.schedHourHelp: Server local time. It may start up to {n} hours later; a missed day is skipped.
quality.schedRunAsNone: It will run with your CRM rights after you save.
quality.schedLastProblem: The last scheduled run found problems. Open it in the list below.
quality.pendingNotice: {n} example(s) suggested by users wait for your review. Approve the good ones (they start running and counting) and delete the rest.
